Agranda todo el texto de la interfaz. La: Scales up every bit of text. Cards and columns grow with it so nothing gets clipped.
Amplia deja más aire entre filas y colum: Spacious leaves more room between rows and columns; compact tightens things up to fit more on the same screen.
Cada lectura recorre sysfs y hwmon. Por: Every reading walks sysfs and hwmon. Below half a second the cost starts to show; above two, the charts lose detail.
El color con el que se resaltan los dato: The colour used to highlight values, charts and the open section.
El español es el original: cuando una fr: Spanish is the original: when a phrase has not been translated yet, it shows in Spanish rather than blank.
Guardar informe del equipo…: Save a report of this machine…
Las líneas se deslizan en vez de avanzar: Lines glide instead of jumping. It changes no reading at all: it just redraws more often, and costs 2% of one core. Press space to freeze what is on screen.
Los mismos datos son 116 MB/s o 931 Mb/s: The same traffic is either 116 MB/s or 931 Mb/s. Speed tests and providers use bits; download managers use bytes.
Por defecto solo se enseñan las banderas: By default only the flags that matter are listed. Turned on, all 53 that CPUID reports on this machine show up.
